messages:
jen_support: hi — acme-inc (tenant id: acme-331) reporting failures on /v1/rerank since yesterday after they upgraded their client. They see 400 with body \"model_id not found\" for model \"tenant_acme_rerank_v1\" and in other calls the API returns scores [0,0,0]. Putting a sample request below and a request id: req_20260316_0452

sanjay_eng: can you paste the full request payload + headers (esp Authorization + model param) and one request_id from logs?

jen_support: sample payload:
```json
{
  "model": "tenant_acme_rerank_v1",
  "input": ["q: how to reset api key", "doc: steps..."],
  "top_k": 5
}
```
headers: Authorization: Bearer sk-live-xxx; X-Request-ID: req_20260316_0452

elaine_cs: how many users impacted? Customer says search ranking dropped in prod, high severity.

tom_ops: adding @sanjay_eng and @rerank-bot. I'll check alias mapping and deprecation logs.

rerank-bot: model-deprecation-notice: model \"tenant_acme_rerank_v1\" marked deprecated 2312300000 by model-cleanup job. Automatic redirect to best-match removed 60m ago.

sanjay_eng: digging in. I see alias 'tenant_acme_reranker' used to map to 'tenant_acme_rerank_v1'. Cleanup removed the actual model artifact so alias resolved to 'embed-text-2' (same prefix match) resulting in incompatible model type on rerank endpoint -> either 400 or zero scores. Repro steps:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $KEY\" \n  -d '{"model":"tenant_acme_rerank_v1","input":["a","b"]}'
```
response: 400 {"error":"model type mismatch: endpoint expects rerank model"} or sometimes 200 with scores [0,0]

sanjay_eng: mitigation: I can temporarily re-create a minimal shim model artifact named 'tenant_acme_rerank_v1' that proxies to an actual rerank model we host. Rolling that in to prevent customer impact.

tom_ops: go ahead, please notify when done.

sanjay_eng: rolled out shim at 2312340000. jen_support can you ask ACME to retry and share a new req id?

jen_support: customer retried, new req id req_20260316_0520 — they report rankings restored and scores look reasonable. Thanks.

sanjay_eng: root cause: model-cleanup job aggressively deleted stale model artifacts; alias fallback logic allowed unrelated model types to match by prefix. Plan: (1) add strict type validation in routing (reject mismatched model types) (2) update cleanup to preserve aliases or alert before deletion (3) add automated rollback to recreate shim for any tenant-critical models. I'll open an RFC and a follow-up ticket.

elaine_cs: please add timeline and impact summary for postmortem. customer wants explanation and a timeline.

jen_support: noted, I'll draft customer-facing summary once RFC linked.

sanjay_eng: ticket created: INF-4281. ETA for hard fix ~48h. I'll put a temporary rule to block model-cleanup for tenant-scoped models until then.

tom_ops: thx all. :thumbsup:
